name: ProCL slot rebalance for the driver slice
description: Allocate a new ProCL program slot dedicated to the driver-slice queries. Train the new slot on accepted failing examples from the driver slice; use batch-averaged attention routing so existing slots are not disturbed. Targets catastrophic forgetting when a new domain has overwritten a previously-accepted behavior.
source_paper_title: Continual Fine-Tuning of LLMs via Program Memory (ProCL)

name: Online-LoRA learning rate decay
description: Reduce the LoRA learning rate for the candidate adapter and re-run training from the prior checkpoint. Targets overfitting to recent feedback batches when the candidate has clearly diverged from baseline behavior on the driver slice.
source_paper_title: Online-LoRA: Task-Free Online Continual Learning via LoRA

name: N-LoRA subspace orthogonalization
description: Project the candidate adapter's LoRA update onto the orthogonal complement of all prior accepted adapters' subspaces. Reduces cross-adapter interference when multiple per-tenant adapters have started overwriting each other's behaviors.

name: Replay buffer: prune recent feedback labels (heuristic)
description: Heuristic, not paper-derived. Identify feedback labels added in the last N days that conflict with the driver-slice held-out queries. Remove them from the replay buffer and re-train the candidate. Targets cases where a small number of recent labels overgeneralized.
source_paper_title: (heuristic — no paper citation; common practice in continual fine-tuning ops)

name: Reduce LoRA rank (heuristic)
description: Heuristic, not paper-derived. Decrease the LoRA rank (e.g. 16 → 8) and re-fine-tune. Targets overfitting symptoms — the candidate has memorized recent feedback at the expense of holding on to broader competence.
source_paper_title: (heuristic — no paper citation; standard PEFT capacity-reduction practice)

name: Silent Collapse trust-throttle
description: Compute the entropy ratio H_g/H_0 over the held-out set. If H_g/H_0 < 0.5 (silent collapse signature from MTR), throttle the candidate's effective learning rate by trust variable τ = max(0.2, H_g/H_0). Targets the canonical silent-collapse failure: the model has flattened its predictive distribution while perplexity stays near baseline.
source_paper_title: Silent Collapse in Recursive Learning Systems (MTR)

name: StableEdit localized patch
description: Apply a localized weight edit targeting only the layers whose representations changed most on the failing slice, leaving the rest of the adapter frozen. Targets cases where one specific behavior needs to be patched without re-training the whole adapter.
